# Contract: reverse-engineer-video

Foundation skill from [simcraft](https://github.com/dotslashsimran/simcraft) at `58224d1` (MIT, Simran Sachdeva), modified by SumitCraft. Category: video. Kind: scripted.

## Purpose
Shot and cut timing, camera-motion estimates, audio cues, contact sheets, a remake plan and matched comparisons for a reference clip.

## Use it for
- "break down this clip's cuts and camera moves"
- "compare my remake with the original"

## Not for
- predict whether this will go viral (out of scope)
- edit my own talking-head footage (rough-cut)

## Accepted inputs
A video file the user may analyse; optionally a remake to compare.

## Deliverables
breakdown.md/json, contact_sheet.jpg, shots_detail.jpg, timeline.png, compare stills or video.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- Python 3.9+
- NumPy
- ffmpeg (on PATH or FFMPEG)

Optional:
- OpenCV (opencv-python-headless)
- faster-whisper or mlx-whisper in rough-cut/.venv (weights 0.5-1.5 GB on first use)
- tesseract OCR

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).

## Local and network behaviour
Local only: reads and writes files on this machine. Whisper weights download on first use if the extra is installed.

## Cost-sensitive operations
None beyond local CPU; optional model download (hundreds of MB).

## Workflow
1. Analyse
2. Check the cuts before trusting anything else
3. Look, then fill in the gaps
4. Remake, then compare at the same timestamps

Full steps: [SKILL.md](SKILL.md).

## Human decisions
- Correct false or missed cuts by eye
- Fill the 'what happens' column and the remake plan

## Quality checks
- Cut times against a synthetic clip with known cuts
- Contact sheet inspected for false/missed cuts

## Common failures
- Dissolves and flashes confuse cut detection
- Fast moves without OpenCV
- No transcript when Whisper is absent (reported as skipped)

## Limitations
- Camera motion and cuts are estimates
- Says nothing about reach or virality

## Reproducible example
A synthetic ffmpeg clip with cuts at known times (evidence/reverse-engineer-video).
